content.name: Coffee

content.name: Saturday pre-orders
content.description: Reserve a sourdough loaf by Thursday evening and collect it on Saturday between 7:00 and 10:30.

content.description: Weekly bread and pastry delivery to local cafes, delivered between 7:00 and 8:00.

content.decision: Hold the sourdough price at $9.00 instead of matching Crumb & Co's new $7.50.

agents.name: Competitor analyst
agents.description: Keeps the Local competitors list current and says what changed.
agents.instructions: Check the four nearby bakeries once a week: price of a sourdough loaf, rating, review count and local search rank. Update the Local competitors collection and only report real changes, with the source file or page you used. If something cannot be checked, say so instead of guessing.

agents.name: Grants researcher
agents.description: Finds and tracks grants the bakery could apply for.
agents.instructions: Find grants the bakery may be eligible for and keep the Grants collection current with amounts, deadlines and what each one pays for. Read the full notice before calling a grant eligible. Flag any missing fact, such as revenue, to the owner.

agents.name: Content writer
agents.description: Drafts newsletters and social posts from approved claims.
agents.instructions: Write the weekly newsletter and social posts in plain, friendly language. Use only claims marked approved in AURA, and link each one to its proof. Leave out anything provisional or retired, and keep the Content calendar up to date.

agents.name: Reviews reader
agents.description: Reads new Google reviews and tallies what customers mention.
agents.instructions: Read new reviews each week and update the Review themes collection with mention counts and average ratings. Quote customers exactly and keep their wording. Tell the owner about any new theme or any review that needs a reply.
